name: worldmesh-relay
description: Your own WorldMesh presence relay: multiplayer for WorldMesh worlds and cities, on your Cloudflare account.

ROOMS.description: One Durable Object per room. It keeps no positions or chat, only the last state of shared objects (a lift, a door) and each room's active minutes today.

WORLD_ROOMS.description: `on`: a room per world, picked from the page's Origin. `off`: named rooms only.

MAX_WORLD_PEERS.description: People at once in one world's room. Default `16`.

WORLD_DAILY_MINUTES.description: Minutes each world's room may be active per UTC day. `0`: no limit. Anyone can point a world at your relay, so set this if you want to cap worlds that aren't yours.

OWN_ORIGINS.description: Your own worlds, exempt from the daily limit: comma-separated origins such as `https://forest.example`, or `*.example.net` for every subdomain.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: The only worlds this relay serves, written like `OWN_ORIGINS`. Any other world is refused, so nobody else's traffic lands on your bill. Empty: every world.

NAMED_ROOMS.description: Named rooms (`/room/<name>`), comma-separated, such as `lobby` for a city's own lobby. Empty: none.

MAX_ROOM_PEERS.description: People at once in one named room. Default `64`.

MAX_WATCHERS.description: Live doorway views watching one room at once, unseen, besides its people. Default `32`; `0` turns watching off.

JOIN_LIMIT.description: WebSocket joins per IP address per minute.

READ_LIMIT.description: Occupancy reads per IP address per minute.
